title: Action validation layer
instructions:
Implement the pure action-validation layer in game-core/src/engine/validate.ts (NO RNG, NO mutation, NO classes). This module answers ONE question: is an Action legal in a given GameState? It never changes the state; a later task (the apply layer / reducer) performs the actual changes after calling this.

STYLE RULES: strict TypeScript with noUncheckedIndexedAccess. No `any`. No classes. No default exports. Never mutate inputs. Import types ONLY from '../types': `import type { GameState, Action, ValidationResult } from '../types';`

File 1: game-core/src/engine/validate.ts
Export exactly ONE function:

`export function validateAction(state: GameState, action: Action): ValidationResult`

ValidationResult is from types.ts: `{ ok: true }` or `{ ok: false; reason: string }`. For every action, run the checks BELOW IN ORDER and return the FIRST failure; if all pass, return { ok: true }. Reason strings MUST match EXACTLY (tests assert them).

Helper lookups (define as private module-level helpers, do NOT export):
- player = state.seats[action.seat] — if undefined, fail with the action's 'unknown seat' reason.
- cardDef(instanceId): const inst = state.cards[instanceId]; if undefined or inst.cardId undefined → undefined. Return state.cardDefs[inst.cardId].

Checks per action type:

1. startGame: if state.phase !== 'setup' → reason 'startGame: not in setup phase'. If action.setup.players.length < 1 or > 5 → 'startGame: bad player count'. Else ok.

2. playActionCard { seat, instanceId }: phase !== 'main' → 'playActionCard: not in main phase'; player undefined → 'playActionCard: unknown seat: N' (interpolate actual seat); player.dead → 'playActionCard: player is dead'; seat !== state.activeSeat → 'playActionCard: not your turn'; player.actionsLeft < 1 → 'playActionCard: no actions left'; instanceId NOT in player.hand → 'playActionCard: card not in hand: ' + instanceId; cardDef(instanceId) undefined → 'playActionCard: unknown card: ' + instanceId; cardDef(instanceId).type !== 'action' → 'playActionCard: not an action card: ' + instanceId. Else ok.

3. playItem { seat, instanceId }: phase !== 'main' → 'playItem: not in main phase'; player undefined → 'playItem: unknown seat: N'; player.dead → 'playItem: player is dead'; seat !== state.activeSeat → 'playItem: not your turn'; instanceId NOT in player.hand → 'playItem: card not in hand: ' + instanceId; cardDef undefined → 'playItem: unknown card: ' + instanceId; type !== 'item' → 'playItem: not an item card: ' + instanceId. (Items are FREE — no actionsLeft check.) Else ok.

4. playAmmo { seat, instanceId }: same shape as playItem but with prefix 'playAmmo' and type check type !== 'ammunition' → 'playAmmo: not an ammo card: ' + instanceId. No actionsLeft check.

5. explore { seat, weapons, ammoCards, exploreCount }: phase !== 'main' → 'explore: not in main phase'; player undefined → 'explore: unknown seat: N'; player.dead → 'explore: player is dead'; seat !== state.activeSeat → 'explore: not your turn'; player.exploresLeft < 1 → 'explore: no explores left'; weapons.length === 0 → 'explore: no weapons'; if weapons has a duplicate instanceId → 'explore: duplicate weapon: ' + id; for each weapon id: NOT in player.hand → 'explore: weapon not in hand: ' + id; cardDef undefined → 'explore: unknown weapon: ' + id; type !== 'weapon' → 'explore: not a weapon: ' + id. For each ammoCards id: NOT in player.hand → 'explore: ammo card not in hand: ' + id; cardDef undefined → 'explore: unknown ammo card: ' + id; type !== 'ammunition' → 'explore: not an ammo card: ' + id. Then ammo math: required = sum of cardDef(weapon).ammoReq (treat missing as 0) for all weapons; available = sum of (cardDef(ammoCard).bonuses?.ammo ?? 0) for all ammoCards; if available < required → 'explore: insufficient ammo'. (exploreCount is accepted as-is; the reduces will not spend more than exploresLeft.) Else ok.

6. buy { seat, pileId }: phase !== 'main' → 'buy: not in main phase'; player undefined → 'buy: unknown seat: N'; player.dead → 'buy: player is dead'; seat !== state.activeSeat → 'buy: not your turn'; player.buysLeft < 1 → 'buy: no buys left'; state.marketPiles[pileId] undefined → 'buy: unknown pile: ' + pileId; pile empty (cards.length === 0) → 'buy: empty pile: ' + pileId; top = pile.cards[0]; cardDef(top) undefined → 'buy: unknown card: ' + top; cardDef(top).cost undefined → 'buy: not for sale: ' + top; player.turnGold < cost → 'buy: insufficient gold'. Else ok.

7. useCharacterAbility { seat, abilityIndex }: phase !== 'main' → 'useCharacterAbility: not in main phase'; player undefined → 'useCharacterAbility: unknown seat: N'; player.dead → 'useCharacterAbility: player is dead'; seat !== state.activeSeat → 'useCharacterAbility: not your turn'; charInst = state.cards[player.characterInstanceId]; charDef = charInst ? state.cardDefs[charInst.cardId] : undefined; charDef undefined or charDef.abilities undefined → 'useCharacterAbility: unknown character: ' + player.characterInstanceId; abilityIndex < 0 or >= charDef.abilities.length → 'useCharacterAbility: bad ability index: ' + abilityIndex. Else ok.

8. endTurn { seat }: phase !== 'main' → 'endTurn: not in main phase'; player undefined → 'endTurn: unknown seat: N'; seat !== state.activeSeat → 'endTurn: not your turn'. (Note: no dead check — a dead seat is never active.) Else ok.

9. chooseOption { seat, promptId, option }: prompt = state.prompts.find(p => p.id === promptId); prompt undefined → 'chooseOption: unknown prompt: ' + promptId; prompt.seat !== seat → 'chooseOption: not your prompt'; option < 0 or >= prompt.options.length → 'chooseOption: bad option: ' + option. Else ok.

File 2: game-core/src/engine/validate.test.ts
Vitest tests (globals are enabled; bare test()/expect() works). Use this EXACT fixture builder (copy verbatim into the test file, then write tests against it):

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'; // optional but harmless
import { validateAction } from './validate';
import type { GameState, CardInstance, CardDef, PlayerState, Action } from '../types';

function seat(s: number, over: Partial<PlayerState> = {}): PlayerState {
  return {
    seat: s, name: 'P' + s, controller: 'human',
    characterInstanceId: 'c' + s, hp: 100, maxHp: 100, decorations: 0, level: 1,
    turnAmmo: 0, turnGold: over.turnGold ?? 50, actionsLeft: over.actionsLeft ?? 1,
    buysLeft: over.buysLeft ?? 1, exploresLeft: over.exploresLeft ?? 1,
    weaponDamageBonusThisTurn: 0, attached: [],
    inventory: [], hand: over.hand ?? ['a-1', 'i-1', 'm-1', 'w-1', 'w-2'],
    discard: [], playArea: [], downed: false, dead: false,
  };
}

function inst(id: string, cardId: string): CardInstance {
  return { instanceId: id, cardId, location: { zone: 'hand', index: 0, seat: 0 } };
}

const DEFS: Record<string, CardDef> = {
  'ac-1':  { id: 'ac-1', name: 'Deadly Aim', type: 'action', set: 'premier', text: '', copies: 5, cost: 50, actionEffects: [{ kind: 'allWeaponsPlusDamageThisTurn', amount: 10 }] },
  'it-1':  { id: 'it-1', name: 'Green Herb', type: 'item', set: 'premier', text: '', copies: 6, cost: 20, itemEffects: [{ kind: 'healFixed20OrTrashWithSecondFor60' }] },
  'am-1':  { id: 'am-1', name: 'Ammo x10', type: 'ammunition', set: 'premier', text: '', copies: 28, bonuses: { ammo: 10, gold: 10 } },
  'we-1':  { id: 'we-1', name: 'Handgun', type: 'weapon', set: 'premier', text: '', copies: 9, cost: 20, ammoReq: 20, damage: 10 },
  'we-2':  { id: 'we-2', name: 'AMG', type: 'weapon', set: 'premier', text: '', copies: 4, cost: 30, ammoReq: 40, damage: 20 },
  'ma-1':  { id: 'ma-1', name: 'Majini', type: 'infected', set: 'premier', text: '', copies: 3, hp: 20, attack: 20, decorations: 1 },
  'ch-1':  { id: 'ch-1', name: 'Chris', type: 'character', set: 'premier', text: '', copies: 1, maxHp: 100, level2At: 4, abilities: [{ kind: 'weaponPlusDamagePerInfectedFought', amount: 5, level: 1 }] },
};

function baseState(over: Partial<GameState> & { seat0?: Partial<PlayerState> } = {}): GameState {
  return {
    version: 1, seed: 1, rngState: 1, phase: over.phase ?? 'main',
    activeSeat: 0, turnNumber: 1,
    seats: [seat(0, over.seat0), seat(1)],
    marketPiles: { hg: { pileId: 'hg', cards: ['mkr-1'] } },
    mansionDeck: ['ma-1i'], mansionBottom: [], removed: [],
    cards: { 'a-1': inst('a-1', 'ac-1'), 'i-1': inst('i-1', 'it-1'), 'm-1': inst('m-1', 'am-1'), 'm-2': inst('m-2', 'am-1'), 'w-1': inst('w-1', 'we-1'), 'w-2': inst('w-2', 'we-2'), 'mkr-1': inst('mkr-1', 'we-1'), 'c0': inst('c0', 'ch-1'), 'c1': inst('c1', 'ch-1'), 'ma-1i': inst('ma-1i', 'ma-1') },
    cardDefs: DEFS, prompts: over.prompts ?? [], winners: [], log: [],
  };
}
```

Then test EXACTLY these cases (use toEqual({ ok: true }) / toEqual({ ok: false, reason: '...' })):

1. playActionCard ok: baseState(), { type: 'playActionCard', seat: 0, instanceId: 'a-1' } → ok true.
2. playActionCard wrong phase: baseState({ phase: 'setup' }), same action → reason 'playActionCard: not in main phase'.
3. playActionCard wrong seat: baseState(), { type: 'playActionCard', seat: 1, instanceId: 'a-1' } → 'playActionCard: not your turn' (the seat check runs before the hand check).
4. playActionCard no actions: baseState({ seat0: { actionsLeft: 0 } }), seat 0, 'a-1' → 'playActionCard: no actions left'.
5. playActionCard card not in hand: baseState({ seat0: { hand: [] } }), seat 0, 'a-1' → 'playActionCard: card not in hand: a-1'.
6. playActionCard not an action: seat 0, 'i-1' → 'playActionCard: not an action card: i-1'.
7. playActionCard unknown card: seat 0, 'zzz' with seat0 hand ['zzz'] → 'playActionCard: unknown card: zzz'.
8. playItem ok: baseState(), { type: 'playItem', seat: 0, instanceId: 'i-1' } → ok true.
9. playItem ok with zero actions: baseState({ seat0: { actionsLeft: 0 } }), 'i-1' → ok true (items free).
10. playItem wrong type: seat 0, 'a-1' → 'playItem: not an item card: a-1'.
11. playAmmo ok: { type: 'playAmmo', seat: 0, instanceId: 'm-1' } → ok true.
12. playAmmo wrong type: seat 0, 'i-1' → 'playAmmo: not an ammo card: i-1'.
13. explore ok: baseState({ seat0: { hand: ['w-1', 'm-1', 'm-2'] } }), { type: 'explore', seat: 0, weapons: ['w-1'], ammoCards: ['m-1', 'm-2'], exploreCount: 1 } → ok true (required = we-1 ammoReq 20; available = 10 + 10 = 20; 20 >= 20). Note 'm-2' is already in the fixture cards map.
14. explore insufficient ammo: baseState(), weapons ['w-1'] (req 20), ammoCards ['m-1'] (avail 10) → 'explore: insufficient ammo'.
15. explore no weapons: weapons [], ammoCards [] → 'explore: no weapons'.
16. explore weapon not in hand: baseState({ seat0: { hand: ['m-1'] } }), weapons ['w-1'], ammoCards [] → 'explore: weapon not in hand: w-1'.
17. explore not a weapon: weapons ['a-1'], ammoCards [] → 'explore: not a weapon: a-1'.
18. explore duplicate weapon: weapons ['w-1', 'w-1'], ammoCards ['m-1'] → 'explore: duplicate weapon: w-1'.
19. explore ammo card not in hand: baseState({ seat0: { hand: ['w-1'] } }), weapons ['w-1'], ammoCards ['m-1'] → 'explore: ammo card not in hand: m-1'.
20. explore not an ammo card: weapons ['w-1'], ammoCards ['a-1'] → 'explore: not an ammo card: a-1'.
21. buy ok: baseState(), { type: 'buy', seat: 0, pileId: 'hg' } → ok true (top mkr-1 = we-1 cost 20 <= turnGold 50).
22. buy insufficient gold: baseState({ seat0: { turnGold: 10 } }), 'hg' → 'buy: insufficient gold'.
23. buy no buys left: baseState({ seat0: { buysLeft: 0 } }), 'hg' → 'buy: no buys left'.
24. buy unknown pile: pileId 'nope' → 'buy: unknown pile: nope'.
25. buy empty pile: baseState({ marketPiles: { hg: { pileId: 'hg', cards: [] } } }), pileId 'hg' → 'buy: empty pile: hg'.
26. useCharacterAbility ok: { type: 'useCharacterAbility', seat: 0, abilityIndex: 0 } → ok true.
27. useCharacterAbility bad index: abilityIndex 5 → 'useCharacterAbility: bad ability index: 5'.
28. useCharacterAbility wrong seat: seat 1 → 'useCharacterAbility: not your turn'.
29. endTurn ok: { type: 'endTurn', seat: 0 } → ok true.
30. endTurn wrong seat: seat 1 → 'endTurn: not your turn'.
31. endTurn setup phase: baseState({ phase: 'setup' }), seat 0 → 'endTurn: not in main phase'.
32. chooseOption ok: baseState({ prompts: [{ id: 'p1', seat: 0, text: 't', options: ['A', 'B'] }] }), { type: 'chooseOption', seat: 0, promptId: 'p1', option: 1 } → ok true.
33. chooseOption unknown prompt: baseState(), promptId 'p9' → 'chooseOption: unknown prompt: p9'.
34. chooseOption not your prompt: prompts [{ id: 'p1', seat: 1, options: ['A'] }], seat 0 → 'chooseOption: not your prompt'.
35. chooseOption bad option: prompts [{ id: 'p1', seat: 0, options: ['A'] }], option 2 → 'chooseOption: bad option: 2'.
36. unknown seat: baseState(), { type: 'endTurn', seat: 9 } → 'endTurn: unknown seat: 9'.
37. dead player: baseState({ seat0: { dead: true } }), playActionCard 'a-1' → 'playActionCard: player is dead'.

Do NOT add or reorder assertions. Export ONLY validateAction.
